cases.description: A refusal carrying sig and no signature: three-member-refusal/v1. sig is the responder's Ed25519 signature over the JCS of {issued_at, reason, request_digest}, the signing input of an evidence-interop/0 or /1 signed refusal.
As three-member-verified, also carrying detail and policy_digest. Neither is signed in this profile, so the signature still verifies.
reason is the empty string, signed. An empty string is a string, and the signature state covers the signature alone, not whether reason is a registered token.
reason is not a registered token. The signature verifies; verified does not make the refusal conforming to Evidence Request.
As three-member-verified, with reason changed after signing.
As three-member-verified, with key_id replaced by another key: the signature does not verify under the key the refusal carries.
reason is an array, signed as such. A signed member that is not a string is invalid, even though the signature verifies over the JCS of the members as carried.
issued_at is absent; sig is over the JCS of the two members present. A signed member that is absent is invalid.
sig without key_id: a signature without a key is invalid. The refusal carries sig, so it is in three-member-refusal/v1 and never signature-unverified.
As three-member-verified, with sig in uppercase hexadecimal: not of the stated form.
key_id is 62 hexadecimal characters: not of the stated form.
sig is JSON null. Presence decides the profile, so the refusal is in three-member-refusal/v1; null is not a string of the stated form, so it is invalid.
A refusal carrying signature: whole-refusal/v1. signature is over the JCS of the refusal without signature, so key_id and detail are signed.
A refusal carrying none of sig, key_id and signature: whole-refusal/v1, with no signature to check.
key_id without signature or sig: a key carried without a signature is invalid.
As whole-refusal-verified, without key_id.
As whole-refusal-verified, with detail changed after signing: every member is signed.
As whole-refusal-verified, with key_id replaced by another key.
A refusal carrying both sig and signature is in whole-refusal/v1. sig is then an ordinary member, covered by signature.

signature is a valid three-member signature (over issued_at, reason and request_digest), carried as signature: the refusal is in whole-refusal/v1, whose signing input also covers key_id, so it does not verify.
A response carrying no responder: digest-bound-artifact-response/v1. sig is over the JCS of the five members plus type evidence-artifact-response/v1, which the verifier supplies.
As response-verified, also carrying type with another value, artifact and an extra member. type is never read from the object, and neither is any other unsigned member.
A response carrying neither key_id nor sig: no signature to check.
As response-verified, also carrying responder: in none of these profiles (for example an interop envelope), so signature-unverified, whatever else it carries.
As response-carries-responder, with responder JSON null: presence decides.
key_id without sig: invalid.
As response-verified, without key_id: invalid.
As response-verified, with anchor changed after signing.
As response-verified, without artifact_kind: a signed member that is absent is invalid.
issued_at is a number, signed as such: a signed member that is not a string is invalid.
sig is over the JCS of the five members without type: the signing input always includes type, so it does not verify.

Signed in three-member-refusal/v1 by a key of small order (the identity point) with R the identity and S zero, which verifies any message. A lenient Ed25519 verifier accepts it; strict Ed25519 refuses it, so the signature is invalid (named after the forged-refusal cases of vectors/interop-profile-v1/).

Signed in three-member-refusal/v1 by the responder's own key with R the identity point, a signature only that key holder can make. A lenient Ed25519 verifier accepts it; strict Ed25519 refuses it, so the signature is invalid (named after the forged-refusal cases of vectors/interop-profile-v1/).

Signed in whole-refusal/v1 by a key of small order (the identity point) with R the identity and S zero, which verifies any message. A lenient Ed25519 verifier accepts it; strict Ed25519 refuses it, so the signature is invalid (named after the forged-refusal cases of vectors/interop-profile-v1/).

Signed in whole-refusal/v1 by the responder's own key with R the identity point, a signature only that key holder can make. A lenient Ed25519 verifier accepts it; strict Ed25519 refuses it, so the signature is invalid (named after the forged-refusal cases of vectors/interop-profile-v1/).

Signed in digest-bound-artifact-response/v1 by a key of small order (the identity point) with R the identity and S zero, which verifies any message. A lenient Ed25519 verifier accepts it; strict Ed25519 refuses it, so the signature is invalid (named after the forged-refusal cases of vectors/interop-profile-v1/).

Signed in digest-bound-artifact-response/v1 by the responder's own key with R the identity point, a signature only that key holder can make. A lenient Ed25519 verifier accepts it; strict Ed25519 refuses it, so the signature is invalid (named after the forged-refusal cases of vectors/interop-profile-v1/).

composed_cases.description: responder-a granted a Bundle; responder-b refused with a three-member-refusal/v1 refusal whose signature verifies. Verified with both profile verifiers set: the refusal signature is verified, nothing is withheld, and a refusal is not a failed claim.
As composed-refusal-verified, with the refusal's reason changed after signing (the member digest recomputed over the refusal as carried): the refusal signature is invalid, so the block fails.
As composed-refusal-verified, with a refusal that carries no key and no signature (whole-refusal/v1, nothing to check): signature-unverified, so the block is withheld.
The agree composition, with responder-a carrying a digest-bound-artifact-response/v1 response bound to its request and its Bundle, signed by responder-a's key: verified, and the block passes.
As composed-response-verified, with issued_at changed after signing: the response signature is invalid, so the block fails.
